default.description: Default capability set for the MeedyaDL application. Grants permissions for file system access, native dialogs, shell execution, OS detection, opening/revealing files and folders, and process management. `shell:allow-open` is for web addresses only (its address pattern refuses anything that is not mailto:/tel:/http(s):, so it can never be used to open a file on disk). Revealing a file or folder — which selects it in the file manager and runs nothing — is `opener:allow-reveal-item-in-dir`. OPENING a file is deliberately NOT granted here: it used to be, with a scope of `**`, and this description used to claim it was "scoped just to that" when it was scoped to everything. On Windows, opening a program runs it, so that was in effect permission for anything running in the page to run any file on the computer. Opening now goes through the `open_downloaded_file` command, which allows music, video, artwork and text and refuses the rest regardless of how the extension is spelled.
